column1: # The balance's final scheme (balance.final): every gun and ammo pair's numbers the solver (BalanceFinalRule) takes. Made by
# notes/balance/final/model/final_check.py from the X904 model (ttk.json) and NTM's gun table; p_role is the share of a click's
# projectiles that hit at the role's range (shotgun 7 blocks, SMG 12, rifle 20, sniper 30).
# spread model: X904 (SpreadModel as of X904; when the spread changes, p_role and this file must be worked out again)
# Fable №2 (2026-11-12): p_stand is the share of a click's projectiles in the target measured by the stand (pass ps): the shooter
# standing and aimed, the target standing at the role's working distance (shot and slug 7, pistol, SMG, MG 12, rifle and beam 20,
# sniper 30), an automatic in a held burst; 0.90 and above written as 1.00, below 0.05 as 0.05 (balance.final.hits = stand)
